race.comment: ZEREALM (7) wasn't far away on debut last start over 1000m at Murray Bridge, finishing fourth and beaten 1.3L. Leading player with plenty of improvement in store. LUNAR VISTA (4) wasn't far off maiden success before a four months break, finishing the prep with a minor placing at Gawler. Sticky draw to overcome but should have enough early speed to offset quickly. Can hit the ground running. BOLD STARLET (8) was well held last time in town but was desperately unlucky not to score the run prior when edged out by Amical. Can bounce back sharply here. PRETTY MORSEL (10) returned from a spell two weeks ago when she was prominent at the bend before fading into sixth. Fitter this time will prove harder to beat. THINE MAJESTIC (12) is a Fierce Impact filly on debut for the Hickmott camp. Has shown positive signs at the trials and is one to keep in mind.
